title: IT WI 3234-11 A1 does not fully cover a requirement of DLW20803_revA_SYNTHETIC p.2
detail:
Requirement: The supplier shall implement and report containment actions (D3) to John Deere within 24 hours
IT: 3.Containment Actions Responsible DueDate Completed Indicar as ações de contenção imediatas: Para cada ação para cada ação . Informar as equipas é indicada a pessoa é indicado um prazo
Analysis: 24-hour reporting deadline to John Deere (specific timeframe for reporting containment actions to John Deere)
action: Update the IT to explicitly state 'Report containment actions to John Deere within 24 hours' in the due date section of the Containment Actions table

title: Conflict: DLW20803_revB_SYNTHETIC p.1 vs WI 3600-11
detail:
Requirement: The supplier shall ensure the sleeve fill rate is at least 98%.
IT: Manga bem ajustada aos fios (cumpre taxa de preenchimento da manga de 95%-100%.) Manga mal ajustada aos fios/Solta (não cumpre taxa de preenchimento da manga de 95%-100%.) 4.1.3 – Bandajar as pontas da manga para fixar aos fios, conforme instrução na tabua de montagem.
Analysis: The requirement states that the sleeve fill rate must be at least 98%. The instruction sentence specifies a sleeve fill rate of 95%-100%. Since the instruction allows for values from 95% to 100%, and the requirement requires at least 98%, every value allowed by the instruction (95-100%) that satisfies the requirement is 98-100%. However, the instruction includes values below 98% (95-97.999...) which do not satisfy the requirement. Therefore, there is a conflict because some values allowed by the instruction (specifically those between 95% and 98%) would violate the requirement. IT requires 95-100% fill rate, requirement demands at least 98%. IT is less strict than requirement (higher minimum).
action: Update the IT to specify a minimum of 98% for sleeve fill rate
